economic_framework.immediate: Required one switch at next observed request; cheapest technically screened alternate for 20 calls.
economic_framework.bounded: Incumbent remains available through permitted grace period; mandatory switch by request 5 or 20; same workload and endpoint feasibility; future token sequence known in hindsight.
economic_framework.fixed: Switch at request 5 or 20; not guaranteed to improve cost.
economic_framework.optional: May stay for full horizon; distinct from timing-only discretion.
economic_framework.caveat: Pure token expenditure holding output/workload constant; service outage and quality differences not priced. Do not infer economic welfare or actual policy adoption.
